item.title: Confetti + Shapes + random(): A Fun Combination!
item.content:encoded: Mix the new random() function with offset-path shapes, sibling-index(), and sibling-count() to build CSS-only confetti explosions, full or partial, that burst on hover.

item.title: Motion Design with CSS Anchors
item.content:encoded: CSS anchor positioning is usually about tethering one element to another, but switching which anchor an element is attached to (and animating between them) turns anchors into waypoints for slick motion effects with very little code.
